## Checklist

* [ ] Targets `main`
* [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — appreciated, not
      required
* [ ] Commit subjects follow `[BUGFIX|TASK|FEATURE] Subject`
* [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
* [ ] `npm test` passes
* [ ] A bugfix comes with a test that fails without it — appreciated,
      not required
* [ ] The JSON schema still matches the parser if the config format
      changed
* [ ] README updated if the change is user facing
